answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Islamic Beliefs Question ID: 62407 Country: DE Title: Book about names of ALLAH and when to say them Question: Could you please recommend a book where it is stated which names of Allah may be said on which purpose (like Ya 'Alim for getting 'Ilm etc.)? Answer ID: 62407 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 111/97/N=02/1437) ‘Aamaal Qurani’ by Hadhrat Maulana Ashraf Ali Sahib Thanvi, may Allah have mercy upon him, contains a supplement under the title ‘Asrar-e-Asmay Rabbani’. Therein the particulars of Asma-e-Husna have been described. So you should study the book. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
